meta.name: Qualify Polish public tenders with Anthropic and Telegram alerts

name: AI agent that qualifies Polish public tenders (Baza Konkurencyjności) into GO / NO-GO

parameters.content:
## AI agent that qualifies Polish public tenders (Baza Konkurencyjności) into GO / NO-GO

### How it works

This workflow checks Polish public tender announcements from Baza Konkurencyjności and qualifies them as GO or NO-GO opportunities. It can be run manually or twice a day, fetches announcements, filters duplicates and irrelevant items, then uses an AI agent to review details and return structured verdicts. Qualified opportunities are formatted into a report and sent to the team via Telegram.

### Setup steps

- Configure the Settings node with the correct list API URL, detail API URL, public URL base, and tender-matching keywords.
- Add credentials for the Anthropic chat model used by the Bid qualification agent.
- Configure the tender_details HTTP tool so it can retrieve full tender details from the detail API.
- Set up Telegram credentials and the target chat/channel in the Notify the team node.
- Review the schedule trigger timing and activate the workflow when ready.

### Customization

Adjust the keywords, AI qualification prompt or scoring criteria, schedule frequency, and Telegram message format to match the organization’s target tenders and review process.

## Start and configure

Manual and scheduled triggers start the workflow, then the Settings node centralizes API endpoints, public URL base, and keyword criteria used downstream.

## Fetch and filter tenders

Retrieves the latest announcements from Baza Konkurencyjności and performs a cheap local pre-filter and deduplication step before invoking the costly AI analysis.

## Qualify with AI

The bid qualification agent evaluates candidate tenders using an Anthropic chat model, an HTTP tool for tender details, and a structured output parser to produce consistent GO / NO-GO verdicts.

## Report and notify

Builds a team-facing report from qualified tender results and sends relevant GO opportunities through Telegram, while keeping NO-GO results in the workflow output.

assignments.name: companyProfile
assignments.value: Two-person software house. We build custom web applications, internal business systems, production and booking software. Stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Docker. We do NOT do: embedded firmware, hardware, construction work, hardware resale, off-the-shelf ERP licences.

assignments.name: dealBreakers
assignments.value: Price carries more than 80% of the award criteria. The subject is off-the-shelf software or licences rather than a custom build. The scope is mostly outside our stack and partial offers are not allowed. Required references or track record we do not have. Deposit or security above what a small company can post.

nodes.name: Claude Language Model
nodes.notes: Swap for OpenAI, Gemini or a local model — any chat model works.

parameters.toolDescription: Fetch the full record of a tender announcement by its numeric ID. Returns the award criteria, estimated value, the real scope description, whether partial offers are allowed, and the contact person. Call it at most once per announcement, and only when the decision genuinely depends on the award criteria or the real scope.
